Eval: Fix agent log mounting path

Currently, `/logs/` folder on container mounts to `runs/{run_id}/{task_id}/{trial_name}/sessions/` path. This is not ideal; it should not have included `sessions` folder.

This PR fixes this problem. Now agents (running inside container) could write logs to `/logs/agent-logs` folder - see example in #413 :

```python
env["SAVE_TRAJECTORY_PATH"] = "/logs/agent-logs"
```

With this PR:

```bash
runs/2025-07-06__09-54-50/broken-python
└── broken-python.1-of-1.2025-07-06__09-54-50
    ├── agent-logs
    │   └── ae7569df-9beb-4118-aa18-8532e3404885-0c8e73fd80775642.json
    ├── commands.txt
    ├── panes
    │   ├── post-agent.txt
    │   ├── post-test.txt
    │   └── pre-agent.txt
    ├── results.json
    └── sessions
        ├── agent.cast
        ├── agent.log
        ├── tests.cast
        └── tests.log

4 directories, 10 files
```

Without this PR:
```bash
runs/2025-07-06__10-02-25/broken-python
└── broken-python.1-of-1.2025-07-06__10-02-25
    ├── agent-logs
    ├── commands.txt
    ├── panes
    │   ├── post-agent.txt
    │   ├── post-test.txt
    │   └── pre-agent.txt
    ├── results.json
    └── sessions
        ├── agent.cast
        ├── agent.log
        ├── tests.cast
        └── tests.log

4 directories, 9 files
```
